title: Global Water Law Judicial Decisions Dataset (2016-2026)
descriptions: Comparative jurimetric corpus of 33,511 judicial decisions on water law across Brazil (11,724), Canada (3,218), and the Netherlands (18,569), 2016-2026. Seven jurimetric variables coded: hr_language, sust_language, governance_cat, win_loss, mp_involvement, indigenous_water, public_interest. Scrapers and coding engine open-source at https://github.com/jrklaus8/water-law-dataset. Also archived on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19836413
